column1: # Reviewed verdicts for Omarchy package files outside /etc/skel, and for /etc files
# that omarchy-settings' .INSTALL overwrites. One exact path per row, no globs.
#   noextract  pacman never installs it (listed in /etc/pacman.d/cachyos-quattro.conf)
#   restore    written by .INSTALL; the CachyOS copy is put back after each transaction
# Rule: noextract when the file changes boot, the initramfs or the kernel command line,
# or overrides a value cachyos-settings sets; allow otherwise. See docs/conflicts.md.
